name: Grilled buffalo
summary: Buffalo cut into squares and grilled over charcoal, the pieces left after the best of the meat is dried.
where: The Thái table. A street was not named.
seoTitle: Thit trau nuong in Son La — grilled buffalo squares
seoDescription: Thịt trâu nướng in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La grills the square pieces over charcoal.
